messages:
Sam: Quick sync 1 1 1 we need final copy + routing for the webinar social slate. Goal: maximize signups from X and LinkedIn w/ minimal ops overhead.
Nora: I can take LinkedIn. Have two hero options: static image or short loop GIF. Which performs better for webinars historically?
Diego: GIF wins for CTR but higher cost to encode. If we keep under 1MB it's fine for X. LinkedIn prefers static for mobile.
Priya: For inbound routing: HubSpot list WL-APR-Q2, then auto-tag campaign=webinar_apr. Can we add an immediate Slack ping to #sales-inbound + DM to the on-call AE?
Sam: Yes. Add a column in the schedule sheet for "notify_ae" with handle. Nora/Diego, pick assets and post sizes.
Nora: Picking GIF for X (600x600 loop) and static 1200x627 for LinkedIn. Uploading to Drive now: /Marketing/Social/AprWebinar/asset_pack_v1/
Diego: Upload done. Filenames: apr_web_gif_v1.mp4, apr_linkedin_static_v1.png. Alt text added.
Sam: Draft posting cadence: 
```
09:00 PT X post (short) + link
09:03 PT X thread (3 replies) w/ GIF
09:10 PT LinkedIn company post
09:30 PT Curated replies + 5 DMs
```
Priya: Routing notes: webhook URL saved in sheet. Ill map UTM params: utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr&utm_content={variant}. Use two CTA variants: "Sign up" and "Watch demo".
Diego: Adding CTR tracking to sheet. Suggest we A/B test CTA on the first X tweet only.
Nora: Copy variants in the doc: /Marketing/Copy/apr_webinar_copy.md (section "social_variants"). Two headline options per platform.
Sam: Engagement plan: reply templates (short):
- Thanks! Here's the link: {link}
- Curious, what workload are you optimizing for?
- Want a 1:1 demo? Drop your email.
Nora: I'll own replies for LinkedIn morning window. Diego will do X replies and DMs. Priya will monitor HubSpot for high-intent tags.
OpsBot: Scheduled social job created: job_id=1798889000-SOCIAL. Runbook: /ops/social_runbook.md.
Sam: One last ask: can we add a tiny creative experiment toggling thumbnail crop (center vs left) on X to see impact on CTR? If yes, mark variant in sheet and include UTM_content=thumb_center/thumb_left.
Diego: Done. Sheet updated with "thumb_variant" column and UTMs.
Priya: Webhook verified. Slack ping set to #sales-inbound and DM to @Diego.
Nora: Final assets live and copy locked. Ready for final sign-off at 4pm PT.
Sam: Awesome. Ship tomorrow at 9am PT if sign-off green. :rocket:
